Hi team,

Great to have Ellen joining us — summary below so we have a single source of truth for handoff. Please reply with any blockers.

Candidate: Ellen Nguyen (Software Engineer, Backend)
Start date: Monday, 16 Nov 2026 (first working day)
Offer: signed (attached: signed_offer_ellen_nguyen.pdf)

Action items:
- Background & employment verification: I've started the process with ClearCheck (threaded below). Ellen, please complete the portal steps when you get the email from onboarding@clearcheck.com.
- I-9 / docs: Ellen, can you upload a copy of an ID + completed I-9 form? HR will schedule an in-person or video session if needed.
- IT provisioning: IT needs laptop preference and whether you'll need VPN/HSM access. IT currently needs the final name and manager (Aditya) to create accounts.
- First-week schedule: Monica, can you confirm orientation times + manager 1:1 slot? Laura, FYI for team intro and onboarding buddy assignment.

Attachments: signed_offer_ellen_nguyen.pdf (signed offer)

Next steps for each owner:
- ClearCheck: please confirm timeline and required candidate actions.
- IT Services: please confirm provisioning ETA once candidate confirms device.
- Monica: send week-one schedule + onboarding checklist.

Thanks — I want to make sure Ellen has a smooth first day.

Best,
Olga
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference

--

Thanks for the ping — please find the provisioning checklist below. Once we have the device choice and manager approval we will queue the build (standard corporate image + monitoring + VPN).

IT provisioning checklist (required to start build):
- Full legal name, preferred name (for display)
- Start date (for SLA scheduling)
- Device choice (MacBook Pro 14, MacBook Air 13, Dell XPS 13)
- Access list: VPN, internal Git, AWS account, KMS/HSM access (requires manager justification)
- Any special peripherals (docking station, external monitor)

Estimated ETA: 5 business days from confirmed request. We will provide temporary credentials for the first day if hardware is delayed.

Attachment: it_account_request_form.xlsx

Thanks,
IT Onboarding Team
VendorCorp Managed Services
